claims: 1 is the first positive integer in the infinite sequence of natural numbers.
1 is the smallest positive integer in the infinite sequence of natural numbers.
A × 1 = a for any number a.
In binary systems, 1 is represented as 1.
1 is represented by the Roman numeral I.
The digit 1 evolved from ancient Sumerian/Babylonian symbols to modern Arabic numerals.
1 is used in prefixes like "mono-", "uni-", and "haplo-".
A Revolut blog post says +1 is the international dialing code for the North American Numbering Plan.
A Revolut blog post says the North American Numbering Plan covers the USA, Canada, and several Caribbean nations
